授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course aims to cultivate design engineers with a solid foundation in engineering skills and acquired design competencies.
Students will acquire CAD techniques for exterior styling of devices, aiming to promote and improve the efficiency of practical prototyping through 3D data.
advice:
Course Overview
Students will acquire fundamental knowledge related to three-dimensional form development in industrial product exteriors, as well as CAD techniques for creating and shaping forms.The course focuses primarily on forms composed of curved surfaces, assuming future development work involving mobility devices and handheld controller-type equipment.

Course Content
1.Knowledge of Three-Dimensional Form Development
2.CAD  Techniques
　Learning CAD operations by creating replica shapes of existing products.
1)Sub-D modeling
　Intuitive modeling method for idea generation.
2)Surface modeling
　Dimensionally defined modeling method with 3D wireframes.
3.Rendering
　Converting 3D models into 2D images by setting surface texture.
requiredKnowledge:
1.No prior knowledge is required; the course is open to students interested in design and design engineering.
2.Will use 3D modeling software RHINOCEROS.

activityGoals.body: To understand basic knowledge of 3D modeling of industrial products.
To be prepared to make functional and aesthetic design proposals.
Be able to create the overall shape of the subject in RHINOCEROS Sub-D modeling mode.
Be able to create the overall shape of the subject in RHINOCEROS surface modeling mode.
Be able to use analysis tools to adjust the geometry.
Be able to visually express the overall shape and the design of the subject to a third party.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) Understood knowledge of 3D modeling and CAD operation method well.
2) Be able to create the equivalent shape of the subject without stopping in Sub-D modeling mode.
3) Understood knowledge of the 3D wireframes and be able to create the equivalent shape of the subject in surface modeling mode with aesthetic analysis.
4) Be able to clearly communicate to a third party with CG images made by the 3D data in rendering mode.
achievementLevels.standard:
1) Understood basic knowledge of 3D modeling and CAD operation method.
2) Be able to create the overall shape of the subject in Sub-D modeling mode.
3) Understood knowledge of the 3D wireframes and be able to create the overall shape of the subject in surface modeling mode.
4) Be able to make CG images using the 3D data in rendering mode.

              Course Overview
Students will acquire fundamental knowledge related to three-dimensional form development in industrial product exteriors, as well as CAD techniques for creating and shaping forms.The course focuses primarily on forms composed of curved surfaces, assuming future development work involving mobility devices and handheld controller-type equipment.

Course Content
1.Knowledge of Three-Dimensional Form Development
2.CAD  Techniques
　Learning CAD operations by creating replica shapes of existing products.
1)Sub-D modeling
　Intuitive modeling method for idea generation.
2)Surface modeling
　Dimensionally defined modeling method with 3D wireframes.
3.Rendering
　Converting 3D models into 2D images by setting surface texture.
